source: Social Wars 0.02a original AS3 + unit SWF PlaceObject tags

as3.directionDetection: Select by signs of targetPixelX-x and targetPixelY-y, preserving current direction when both deltas under tile pixel dimensions /3
as3.attackDirectionFlow: IsoUnit.updateDirection() calls updateUnitDirectionTile(target tx/ty) for active attacking target
as3.projectileStart: Try bmd.getChildAt(0).getChildByName(clipName), transform localToGlobal then parent.globalToLocal; else start=(x, y-bmd.height*0.6) or (x,y) if bmd null.
as3.projectileHit: Try ghostBuilding direct child marker; otherwise use ghostBuilding.getBounds(this) adjusted by ProjectileDefinition.verticalOffset.

bushwacker.caution: These are nested timeline placement coordinates in twips, not stage/world muzzle coordinates. Parent matrix chain and bmd.getChildAt(0) need verification.

reaperDrone.caution: No named PlaceObject marker found in the SWF. Runtime script-created children or other conditions are not proven absent; original getter's fallback would apply if no named child.

implementation.sceneFacing: scene.ts stores facing per unit, recomputes signed screen-space direction on attack
implementation.renderFacing: Reaper Drone pose automatically chooses one of five SWF root frames and horizontal Canvas mirroring
implementation.visualProjectileOrigin: Reaper fallback y - displayHeight*0.6 applied with demo scaled 161px height. This demo height is NOT native bmd.height. Bushwacker muzzle remains provisional pending nested transform chain.
implementation.sceneStatus: independent Canvas+TypeScript; no original SWF run in browser
